headline: Last session: Indian markets traded with caution as global warnings and upcoming domestic corporate triggers kept investors on edge.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Tata Trusts has declared the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons Chairman to be legally invalid and void ab initio
Ashiana Housing announced plans to invest Rs 1,000 crore on land acquisition during the current fiscal year
Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and fluctuations in crude oil prices are expected to drive market sentiment this week
The Agro Chem Federation of India is seeking a multi-crore scheme to reduce dependence on China for crop protection
whatHappening: Gwalior is set to host Asia's first telecom manufacturing zone with 24 companies currently seeking entry
NSE shareholders have retained significant stakes even after participating in the recent Offer for Sale
New regulations for LPG refills will require eKYC completion by October 1 to avoid market-price charges for households
Market analysts are monitoring GIFT Nifty and other Asian indices for cues ahead of the next trading session
summary: The Indian stock market is currently closed for a long weekend and will resume trading on Tuesday. The last session was marked by global market warnings, while weekend developments were dominated by a leadership dispute at Tata Sons and significant investment news from Ashiana Housing. Investors are now looking toward geopolitical cues and domestic manufacturing developments to guide the upcoming reopening.
